properties.title: How a failed attack in Leipzig revealed a wider Russian campaign of attacks
properties.summary: BERLIN — If the explosive had actually detonated, investigators might not have gotten their clearest look yet at what European officials believe is a wider Russian campaign of attacks. properties.title: Russia expels Hungarian diplomats as Budapest breaks with Orbán era
properties.summary: Moscow ordered Hungarian embassy and consulate staff out just weeks after Budapest expelled 10 Russian diplomats on national security grounds in September, the first such move by Hungary since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

properties.title: Iranian airliner with passengers on board seized at Istanbul over €3-million debt
properties.summary: Bailiffs boarded the Caspian Airlines Boeing 737 as passengers sat ready for departure and served a €3 million debt order before it could take off. The seizure came days after US secondary sanctions on Iran's aviation sector took effect, halving international flights at Tehran's main airport.
